name: Masajes Personalizados By Fabian
address: 2750 N 29th Ave #313, Hollywood, FL 33020, United States
website_check: No field on Google Business ('Add website' shown). Web search for the business name, phone number and the owner's own marketing tagline 'Healing Hands by Fabian' found no personal domain, Instagram or Facebook page. Only third-party directory listings (Fresha, MassageBook) exist.

hours.source: Google Maps hours field, corroborated by the business's own Google photo flyer ('Healing Hands by Fabian ... Abierto hasta el sabado a la medianoche')

language_evidence: Business's own promotional flyer (a photo in the Google Business gallery) is written in Spanish ('Masajista en Hollywood', 'Abierto hasta el sabado a la medianoche'). Reviews found are in English, kept verbatim in the site. Hollywood, FL has a large Spanish-speaking population; site defaults to Spanish with full EN toggle.
services_real: Therapeutic massage (most mentioned in reviews: lower back, sciatic and shoulder pain relief)
Thai massage (confirmed via Fresha directory listing for this business)
Personalized session (matches the business's own name, 'Masajes Personalizados')
pricing_note: No prices published anywhere found (Google Maps, Fresha, MassageBook). Site uses 'call for pricing' per adapted-variant rule.

reviews_verbatim.author: Ana Llerena
reviews_verbatim.text: Had a wonderful experience. Was a Mother's Day gift from my son and daughter in law. Didn't know what to expect since I suffer from lower back sciatic pain and Alex has healing hand. Left with no sciatic pain. Definitely coming back for healing. Thank you!!!

reviews_verbatim.author: James Schrader
reviews_verbatim.text: Highly recommended. From a warm and friendly greeting. Alex does amazing work. Came in with lower back pain and shoulder pain. I walked out feeling great. Very professional and attentive. Makes sure pressure is just right.

reviews_verbatim.author: Ric Bonilla
reviews_verbatim.text: Fabian is an excellent massage therapist. My monthly visits to him have produced more range of motion in my arms and has relieved much of my lower back pain.

note_on_therapist_name: The business is named 'By Fabian' and the owner's own photo flyer in the Google gallery reads 'Healing Hands by Fabian'. Two of the three review quotes used refer to the therapist as 'Alex' verbatim (kept unedited, as found) rather than Fabian; this may be a nickname or a second therapist. Not altered since reviews must stay verbatim.
